customManagers.description: Trusted-images inventory upstream tracking: captures ref, tag and digest from every inventory/<app>/image.yaml entry so Renovate opens PRs on upstream version bumps AND same-tag digest drift. Versioning is loose, never default docker, so the internal -bocklabs.N revision suffix orders numerically. No automerge anywhere: each inventory-bump PR is manually reviewed because its merge gates a future promotion run (fail-closed posture).
